text:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran a surface scan for audit events across services. Found uneven signal for: api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. Need quick triage and backlog picks.
pranav: Can you attach the checklist or sample events? I'll run a shim in staging.
maria: attaching quick excerpts below, not exhaustive. key gaps: missing 'grant' and 'revoke' for RBAC in console, billing misses 'invoice.download' events, gateway doesn't consistently emit upstream client_id.
jen: noted. for runtime, do we have per-invocation KMS key_id in logs? last I checked we had only key alias.
maria: correct — runtime currently logs key_alias only. KMS team advised key_id would be a PII concern for some customers; flagged to security.
leo: for billing, we probably want invoice.download + permission checks + ip. adding to backlog.
pranav: ops-bot created a quick diffs manifest against schema v2. snippet:
```json
{"event_type":"billing.invoice.download","user":"{user_id}","resource":"{invoice_id}","ip":"{ip}","authz":"{decision}"}
```
jen: +1. Also need to standardize actor.identity vs actor.user_id across services.
maria: proposed triage plan: 1) map missing event types by service (owner) 2) decide schema normalization (actor.*, key_id vs key_alias) 3) customer-facing validation tests 4) backlog tickets + ETA.
leo: I'll own billing mappings. ETA EOW for initial events list.
pranav: I'll take api-gateway and runtime. For runtime I'll check KMS opt-in for key_id. ETA Wed.
jen: I'll draft schema normalization proposal and a validation harness (pytest). ETA Thu.
maria: great. @ops-bot please create tickets: eng/security backlog, tag owners, link audit-schema-proposal PR when ready.
ops-bot: Created tickets #SEC-4182 (api-gateway/runtime gaps), #SEC-4183 (billing download event), #SEC-4184 (schema-normalize). Links: https://go/SEC-4182 https://go/SEC-4183 https://go/SEC-4184 :white_check_mark: 
maria: thanks. one more thing — customer evidence pack; we need an audit event sample for SOC2/ISO requests. can owners attach sample events to the ticket.
leo: will attach billing sample events to #SEC-4183.
pranav: will add runtime KMS notes to #SEC-4182.
jen: starting schema doc now, will @maria for review.
maria: solid. if no blockers, we'll surface to compliance sync on Friday. :thumbsup:
